headline.definition: A script TRANSFERS FULLY when the production member door (memberPaneDefinition -> installUserDefinitions; objects-only pane armed, runtime pane dark) attaches it with zero refusals, with nothing dropped or withheld from its object program and no per-bar paint withheld. Door acceptance, not numeric parity.

parity.note: vendor-harness verdicts over tests/fixtures/vendor/harness (RDDT/SPY daily captures of corpus scripts and probes)

features.label: var declarations (state that persists across bars)
method-call syntax  x.f(...) on a value
ta.* called inside an if / loop / switch arm or a function body (per-call-site history)

labels.imperative: Imperative execution: if/for/while blocks, := reassignment, var state carried across bars
labels.collections: Arrays, matrices and maps as values
labels.imports-libraries: import of published libraries / library() scripts
labels.strategy: strategy() order simulation and strategy.* values
labels.request-security: request.security / request.* across symbols and timeframes
labels.text-colour-values: Text and colour as computed values
labels.history-offsets: History references and offsets beyond literal whole numbers
labels.builtin-missing: A built-in name the door does not know
labels.call-mapping: A known name whose call shape / argument order is not mapped
labels.drawing-objects: Drawing objects (line/label/box/table/polyline/linefill): ops dropped or withheld
labels.output-contract: Script offers nothing the pane carries (no plot, hidden-only, constant-only)

runtimeOn.definition: The member door with the runtime pane ON at every peel step, as a permitted member with every script graded (the server's starter allowlist is NOT applied: an upper bound). A script transfers when it transfers fully on the host lane or attaches on the runtime lane, and is not a strategy that places orders. Door acceptance, not numeric parity.
